content: Plausible and GoatCounter are the two leading cookieless, privacy-friendly analytics options for static sites. Plausible script is ~1KB-2KB (vs ~45KB GA4), no cookie banner needed under GDPR since no personal data is tracked. GoatCounter is free for low-traffic personal sites (donation-supported) and self-hostable; adds ~3.5KB. Both integrate via a single <script> tag in public/index.html or App.vue mounted hook -- no build changes needed.
